searchText: Sorry I didn't realize you were OOO. Maybe <@586161934425128960> can respond instead. Why would you set `CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH` to zero here though? In the test, we set it to 1 so we can specify a pre-capella time. See: I didn't understand why that was an issue tbh we passed capella tests before I think it's an issue because we do not override `*_FORK_EPOCH` values for other forks. So it would pass if you ran it in capella, but fail if you ran it in deneb. Because you're using those values to determine what the current fork is. I suggested using the manifest (or test filepath) to determine the fork. But it doesn't sound like that's a trivial thing to do. Not sure.
